customManagers.description: go.mod's go directive as a docker-datasource dep, so it shares depName/packageFileDir with its Dockerfile's golang base image and the default grouping rule below bundles them into one PR
aws-emulator version pinned in the e2e stack script, from the aws/aws-emulator GitHub releases

packageRules.description: go.mod's go directive is owned by the custom manager above, not the stock gomod manager
Track OpenTofu releases instead of Terraform for required_version
e2e does not run on pull requests, so automerging an emulator update would ship it untested, and frequent releases are batched into one weekly update
